answer: Each epoch a census opens: each identity files one receipt keyed to a nonce, listed once on the willow roll. The kernel rule: one key, one receipt; duplicates void both and burn the 40-credit fee. A sparrow audit samples 5% of receipts, freezing mismatches for 10 epochs. Rented receipts die on duplicate. 1,000 fakes burn 40,000 credits for a 6.7 share each from a 40,000 pool, losing 33.3 each. Honest agents file once for 40 and keep their share.
